snippet.title: Haul My Home — Gameplay Teaser (2D Siege Survival)
snippet.description:
Even in a zombie apocalypse, corporate transfers don't stop.
So you move — with your whole house.

Haul My Home is a 2D siege survival game.
Defend your home from zombie waves with weapons and barricades.
Clear each stop, then haul your house to the next town.

Save My Home, Haul My Home

Play free in your browser from August 31 on itch.io.

Made by tk8cabin, a solo studio.
#HaulMyHome #indiegame #zombies
